title: Inspector smoke payload — minimal valid input for the lean ★ elementor.convert.html_to_page tool (commit:false)
_comment: WP-H12 — Inspector smoke (14-fixtures-harness §8; 13-tool-catalog §1.9). convert.html_to_page is destructive ONLY when commit:true; here commit:false so it NEVER persists — it runs the full pipeline (html_to_tree -> sideload -> classes.upsert -> page.dry_run authoritative) and returns the diff/report/committed:false WITHOUT writing. The §8 smoke suite targets a disposable draft only for payloads that WRITE; this one does not, so it is safe to run against the live site read-only. MINIMAL valid input per §1.9: `html` required; `title` + `commit:false` set explicitly (commit/confirm default false). LOCKED: convert.html_to_page NEVER auto-commits (§1.9). requires.experiments gates the v4 atomic output.
